This is a dated October27report followed up on November2. NIST IR8547 is final;its first PQC standards date to August2024 and the draft to November12,2024. Federal high-value/high-impact key establishment and signatures have end2030/end2031milestones;2035is the broad federal target. These scope-specific targets differ from a universal business deadline or a quantum-arrival forecast. PQC runs on conventional computers. Harvest-now/decrypt-later is a risk mechanism,not a documented breach here. Signatures support origin/integrity under valid key/trust assumptions;they alone establish neither identity truth nor content truth. Hybrid designs add computing costs;Gemini’s “ensures” wording exceeds a universal security guarantee. Lock/envelope imagery is analogy. NCCoE work is documented migration support,not proof of completed deployments.

这是11月2日跟进的10月27日报告，保留实际日期。NIST IR8547已定稿；首批后量子标准发布于2024年8月，草案日期为2024年11月12日。重点联邦高价值／高影响系统的密钥建立与签名，分别对应2030／2031年底节点，较广联邦目标为2035年。适用范围有别于所有企业的统一期限，日期也非量子计算机到来预测。算法运行于普通电脑；先收集后解密描述风险机制，本文无具体泄露个案。数字签名在密钥与信任条件成立时支持来源及完整性核验，内容真实性仍有其他条件。混合方案增加计算成本，安全性依赖具体设计与实现。锁箱、信封均为比喻；NCCoE是迁移支持项目，实际完成部署另需证据。
